description.zh: 显示名称，用于页面显示，便于明确账号使用场景
description.en: The display name of the member. This helps clarify the scenario in which the account is used.
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that is used as the member.
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that is used as the management account.

description.zh:
授予子账号的权限数据，权限点如下：

- 允许同步信控身份给关联账号:SYNCHRONIZE\_FINANCE\_IDENTITY
- 允许同步优惠给关联账号:SYNCHRONIZE\_FINANCE\_DISCOUNT\_POLICY\_TO\_TARGET
- 禁止关联账户余额提现:FORBID\_WITHDRAW\_CASH
- 禁止关联账户管理发票:FORBID\_MANAGE\_INVOICE
- 请求查看财务关联信息:CHECK\_FINANCE\_INFO
- 允许管理目标发票:MANAGE\_TARGET\_INVOICE
- 允许查看关联账户消费信息:CHECK\_TARGET\_CONSUMPTION
description.en:
The permissions that can be granted to the member. Valid values:

*   SYNCHRONIZE_FINANCE_IDENTITY: allows the credit control identity to be shared with the member.
*   SYNCHRONIZE_FINANCE_DISCOUNT_POLICY_TO_TARGET: allows the discount policy to be shared with the member.
*   FORBID_WITHDRAW_CASH: does not allow the member to withdraw the balance.
*   FORBID_MANAGE_INVOICE: does not allow the member to manage invoices.
*   CHECK_FINANCE_INFO: requests to view information about the financial relationship.
*   MANAGE_TARGET_INVOICE: allows the member to manage invoices.
*   CHECK_TARGET_CONSUMPTION: allows the member to view the bills.

The params[PermissionCodes, RoleCodes] can not be null at the same time.
The type of the financial relationship. Set the value to enterprise_group.

description.zh: 请求唯一标识，用于标记一次请求，便于定位问题
description.en: The unique ID of the request. The ID is used to mark a request and troubleshoot a problem.

description.zh: 授予子账号角色，目前仅支持财务托管角色(trusteeship)
description.en: The roles that can be assigned to the member. Set the value to trusteeship.

descriptions.zh:
1、具体财务关联业务规则参见<props="china">[邀请关联账号]( https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/100376.html)</props><props="intl">[财务托管协议]( https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/doc-detail/116383.html)</props>。
2、如果邀约主、子账号实名认证一致，则不需要子账号通过OpenAPI再次确认，否则需要调用ConfirmRelation确认。
descriptions.en:
For more information about a financial relationship, see <props="intl">[Usage notes on the trusteeship]( https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/doc-detail/116383.html)</props>. 

If enterprise names used by the management account and a member for real-name verification are the same, you do not need to call an API operation for confirmation. Otherwise, you must call the ConfirmRelation operation for confirmation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun bssopenapi add-account-relation --relation-type enterprise_group --parent-user-id 1738376485192612 --child-nick 'xxx项目' --child-user-id 1512996702208737 --request-id 32324242444 --permission-codes SYNCHRONIZE_FINANCE_IDENTITY --role-codes trusteeship --api-version 2017-12-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun bssopenapi AddAccountRelation --region cn-hangzhou --ChildUserId 1512996702208737 --ParentUserId 1738376485192612 --RequestId 32324242444 --RelationType enterprise_group --RoleCodes.1 trusteeship --PermissionCodes.1 SYNCHRONIZE_FINANCE_IDENTITY --ChildNick 'xxx项目'
